# World Bank Open Data

> > Comprehensive economic, social, and environmental development indicators for countries worldwide, including GDP, poverty metrics, Human Capital Index, and Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) data.

World Bank Open Data provides free access to global development statistics, covering economic indicators, population data, environmental metrics, and social development measures. The platform serves as the primary repository for internationally comparable development data, sourced from the World Bank, ILO, and other international organizations.

## Key Topics

- World Bank
- GDP statistics
- Human Capital Index
- Sustainable Development Goals (SDG)
- Poverty metrics
- Economic indicators
- Social indicators
- Development statistics
- Population data
- Environmental data
- PPP (Purchasing Power Parity)
- International Labour Organization (ILO)
- Global Economic Prospects
- LULUCF (Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry)
- Country-level development data

## Major Economies & High-Population Countries

- [Nigeria | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/nigeria): Nigeria development data: GDP, poverty, Human Capital Index metrics
- [France | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/france): France economic, social & environmental indicators from World Bank
- [Thailand | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/thailand): Thailand development data: GDP, poverty, Human Capital Index metrics
- [Myanmar | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/myanmar): Myanmar economic & social indicators: GDP, poverty, population data
- [Netherlands | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/netherlands): Netherlands economic & development statistics from World Bank
- [Morocco | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/morocco): Morocco development metrics: GDP, poverty, Human Capital Index data

## European Countries

- [Slovenia | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/slovenia): Slovenia indicators: economic, social, environmental & SDG data

## Sub-Saharan Africa

- [Rwanda | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/rwanda): Rwanda development data: GDP, poverty metrics, population statistics
- [Gabon | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/gabon): Gabon country data: economic, social & development statistics
- [Equatorial Guinea | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/equatorial-guinea): Equatorial Guinea indicators: GDP, poverty, Human Capital Index, SDG

## Middle East & North Africa

- [Bahrain | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/bahrain): Bahrain statistics: GDP, Human Capital Index, environmental data

## Caribbean & Latin America

- [Jamaica | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/jamaica): Jamaica development statistics: GDP, poverty, environmental metrics
- [Guyana | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/guyana): Guyana data: GDP, population, environmental & social indicators

## East Asia & Pacific

- [Brunei Darussalam | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/brunei-darussalam): Brunei economic, social & environmental indicators from World Bank

## Optional: Pacific Islands & Territories

- [Guam | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/guam): Guam economic, social & environmental data from World Bank
- [Northern Mariana Islands | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/northern-mariana-islands): Northern Mariana Islands development & economic indicators
- [Tonga | Data](https://data.worldbank.org/country/tonga): Tonga economic & social statistics from World Bank data
